scripts.build: npm run build -w @restful/shared && npm run build -w @restful/service-kit && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run prisma:migrate:deploy -w @restful/user-service && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy -w @restful/auth-service && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy -w @restful/file-service
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run prisma:migrate:dev -w @restful/user-service && npm run prisma:migrate:dev -w @restful/auth-service && npm run prisma:migrate:dev -w @restful/file-service
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed -w @restful/user-service && npm run db:seed -w @restful/auth-service
